title: [Derelict Queen, Ramp]
description: While the outer hull of The Derelict Queen is battle-scarred, the bow is pristine, with polished interlocking oak and teak decks and a carved mahogany figurehead.  Ivory canvas sails are attached to sturdy masts with neatly arranged rigging, while a brilliant incarnadine sail edged in midnight black stands out at the foresail.  Fluttering in the ocean breeze, a flag flies from the prow.
